scope: Unloaded EMAX servo, linkage disconnected,5V. Analyze logged command register writes and wiper ADC, not pulse edges, calibrated rotor/shaft angle, or physical deadtime constants.
data_state_at_declaration: New characterization recording has not been read or analyzed. Earlier short bench servo recording informed impulse/noise precautions only.
trial_time_zero: First Blackbox sample at which debug[1] changes to the new commanded PWM. Native servo[5] must agree.
baseline: Median of raw ADC during final200ms before t0; robust sigma=1.4826*median(abs(x-median(x))).
endpoint: Median of raw ADC during final300ms of the current1.2s hold, before the next command.
credible_response: Reject span smaller than max(10*prestep robust sigma,10ADC counts). Report reason rather than fabricate metrics.
orientation: Progress=(ADC-baseline)/(steady_endpoint-baseline); increasing progress always follows current commanded movement.

onset.signal: raw ADC, no smoothing phase shift
onset.threshold_counts: max(3*prestep robust sigma,2%absolute trial ADC span,3ADC counts)
onset.sustain: At least5 consecutive recorded samples beyond threshold; timestamp first sample of accepted run.
onset.spike_rejection: Candidate must reach a sustained10% crossing without returning below half-onset-threshold toward baseline, and remain outside that baseline band for10ms after the sustained10% crossing. Reject earlier command-correlated impulses that fail this continuity check.
onset.interpretation: Thresholded first sustained wiper response estimate; not earliest infinitesimal motion or a physical transport delay.

impulse_cleaning_for_smoothed_metrics.method: Centered7-sample local median. Replace points farther than max(6*prestep robust sigma,6ADC counts) from that median.
impulse_cleaning_for_smoothed_metrics.record: Store replacement count and times. Raw onset and raw single-peak overshoot remain uncleaned. True very short excursions can be attenuated.

smoothing_and_derivative.primary: Centered local-linear regression over11 samples using actual FC timestamps. Fitted center value is smoothed position; slope is ADCcounts/s.
smoothing_and_derivative.sensitivity: Repeat at21samples; report both and relative change of peak derivative. No differentiation of unfiltered samples used as primary velocity.
smoothing_and_derivative.edges: Use only complete regression windows within each pre/hold segment; never use samples after the next command.

movement_times: On primary smoothed progress, first sustained5-sample crossings of10%,50%,90%; report t10,t50,t90 relative to t0 and t90-t10. Also report mean10–90slew=0.8*trialspan/(t90-t10).
derivative: Report peak slope in commanded direction, corresponding signed ADCcounts/s, and absolute peak/pooled measured full1100–1700ADCspan per second. Report21sample sensitivity. No degrees/s.

overshoot.filtered_sustained: max(0,max over5sample windows of minimum smoothed progress in window-1)*100%; requires a sustained excursion.
overshoot.reference: Actual steady endpoint median of each trial, not nominal PWM/voltage. Report whether excursion exceeds3*prestep noise sigma.

settling.strict_bands: ±2% and±5% of absolute trialspan around actual endpoint.
settling.condition: Earliest primary smoothed sample after which every remaining usable sample lies in band, with at least100ms remaining observation. Otherwise right-censor at usable hold duration.
settling.noise: Flag strict band narrower than3*rawprestep robust sigma. Also report separately named noise-adjusted settling using max(strictband,3sigma), never silently substitute it.

normalization: Fullspan is pooled median endpoint ADC at1100 minus pooled median endpoint ADC at1700, absolute value. It is an observed electrical span, not mechanical angle calibration.
history: Stratify by fromPWM,toPWM and continuation/reversal/unknown relative to preceding command step. Distinguish cycle block, low-pair block, high-pair block; first transitions between blocks retain actual history.
statistics: For every transition+history group: n,median,25th/75thpercentiles,min/max; no unlabelled pooling across history. Censored/invalid counts retained. Optional deterministic bootstrap95%CI for median withseed20261106 and10000resamples when n≥5.
matched_comparisons: 1420→1700 vs1700→1420 is equal280µs.1420→1100 vs1100→1420 is equal320µs. Do not compare280vs320µs durations as equal-amplitude direction tests.
synthetic_validation: Known onset and linear-ramp10–90/velocity; positive and negative directions; injected short command impulses; sustained overshoot and settling; no-response rejection; window sensitivity.
